{{Removed|date=4th of December 2021}} {{For|[[Glitch]]|[[Error]], [[Bug]]|[[Giant Boss]]}} {{Zombie |image1 = [[File:GlitchedGiant-0.png]] |mode_appearance = [[Fallen Mode|{{Color|LegacyFallenMode|Fallen}}]] |first_wave_appearance = [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|???]] |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]25,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Fast (5) |spawned_by = [[Creator]] |cash = {{Money|5}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Glitched Giant''' was a special [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]], and thus only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. The '''Glitched Giant''' walked at a slightly fast speed and had an insane amount of health. This enemy was incredibly dangerous for this reason. The '''Glitched Giant''' could also be spawned by the [[Creator]]. ==Appearance== The '''Glitched Giant''' had a similar to style the first version of the [[Giant Boss]], with the same spikes attached to the [[Enemies|enemy]]. However, a sword was stabbed into the back instead of a knife. It was also faceless. It had a granite shirt and pants. Its arms, spikes, shirt, pants and head were sometimes glowing neon and can be a different range of colors. The colors change every second. Glitchy particles could be seen emitting from its torso, similar to the [[Glitch]]. It had a twisted left leg. ==Strategy== *As with other [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]] [[enemies]], high DPS towers, such as the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Ranger]], are recommended. **The [[Commander]] is highly recommended to boost the firerate of these towers. *The [[Freezer]], the [[Frost Blaster]] and the [[Sledger]] can slow down this enemy, allowing you towers more time to attack the '''Glitched Giant'''. This is recommended as they have an outrageous amount of health. ** Be aware that, due to the '''Glitched Giant's''' large size, it can only be slowed down for a shorter period of time compared to an average-sized enemy. **The [[Electroshocker]] can only slow the '''Glitched Giant''' for a shorter period of time instead of fully stopping it due to its large size and [[Stun Immunity]]. **The [[Sledger]] is recommended to freeze this enemy because it performs one of the highest DPS as a support tower. *The [[Toxic Gunner]] can permanently slow down the '''Glitched Giant''' by 50%, making it recommended to use. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} GlitchedGiant1.png|First version, First animation (25 November 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Glitched Giant''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GlitchedGiantIconIG.png|'''Glitched Giant''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Glitched Giant''' is a fusion between the [[Glitch]], [[Giant Boss]] and [[Bug]], inheriting traits from all three [[enemies]]. ==Update History== *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Glitched Giant''' added. *'''29 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.4|Release v1.4.0]] **Health increased from 10,000 to 20,000. **Speed increased from Below Average to Slightly Fast (5). *'''24 December 2019''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.0]] **Health increased from 20,000 to 25,000. *'''14 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **Now has [[Partial Electric Immunity]]. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. **Animation changed. *'''4 December 2021''' -
